caption: Each row is one frame timeline in milliseconds: a tracking bar, a rendering bar and a narrow 1.5 ms app slice. The normal frame fits the 16.67 ms budget at 15.5 ms, the dark corridor pushes tracking to 9.0 ms and the frame to 18.5 ms, and rendering must fall to 6.17 ms to get back to 60 frames per second.

spec.aria: Frame-time budget from the worked example: one row shows the 16.67 ms budget, one the normal 15.5 ms frame, one the 18.5 ms dark-corridor frame, and one the repaired frame where rendering drops from 8.0 to 6.17 ms while tracking stays at 9.0 ms and the app slice stays 1.5 ms.
